As Microsoft (MSFT) Share Price Declined, Cape Cod Five Cents Savings Bank Decreased Its Position; Twenty First Centy Fox (FOX) Shareholder Baupost Group Has Upped Its Stake by $167.16 Million as Valuation Rose Posted by Leroy Gutman on January 20, 2019 at 6:40 pm
Baupost Group Llc increased its stake in Twenty First Centy Fox Inc (FOX) by 27.3% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Baupost Group Llc bought 3.71M shares as the company’s stock rose 10.28% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 17.32M shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $793.65 million, up from 13.61M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Baupost Group Llc who had been investing in Twenty First Centy Fox Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $90.08 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.60% or $0.29 during the last trading session, reaching $48.35. About 4.63M shares traded. Twenty-First Century Fox, Inc. (NASDAQ:FOX) has risen 45.16% since January 20, 2018 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.16% the S&P500.
Cape Cod Five Cents Savings Bank decreased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 1.93% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cape Cod Five Cents Savings Bank sold 2,842 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.64% with the market. The institutional investor held 144,336 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $16.51 million, down from 147,178 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cape Cod Five Cents Savings Bank who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $826.95B market cap company. The stock increased 1.50% or $1.59 during the last trading session, reaching $107.71. About 37.43 million shares traded. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 30.43% since January 20, 2018 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 30.43% the S&P500.
